alerts.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued October 24 at 3:10PM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
alerts.description:
ESFHFO

A significant pattern change is expected Monday night through at
least Thursday as deep tropical moisture is brought north. A
combination of surface lows and troughs will bring exceptionally
moist air over the eastern end of the state beginning Monday night
and extending to all islands Tuesday. Heavy rain and thunderstorms
are possible throughout this period. Models have not converged on
details yet, so exact locations, timing, and rainfall amounts are not
certain. Please be prepared for periods of heavy rain this coming
week.

Keep up to date with the latest forecast information through the
Internet (weather.gov/hawaii), local media, social media, or NOAA
Weather Radio broadcasts.

An updated outlook will be issued Sunday by 6 AM HST or sooner if
necessary.

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS Central Pacific Hurricane Center Honolulu HI
Issued by NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 PM HST Sat Oct 24 2026

For the central North Pacific...between 140W and 180W:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Hurricane
Vance, located a few hundred miles southwest of Acapulco, Mexico.

Western Central Pacific:
Showers and thunderstorms are a little better organized in
association with a broad area of low pressure located just west of
the International Date Line, several hundred miles west of Johnston
Atoll. Some development of this system is possible over the next few
days while it moves east-northeastward at 10 to 15 mph. By the
middle of next week, however, strong upper-level winds should limit
any additional development.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.

$$
Forecaster Cangialosi
NNNN
